independent_unit: A KnotPlot generator/topology/parameter-condition trajectory; generator-family comparisons are not independent physical replication.
parser_contract: Historical .kpc files are parsed as UTF-8 text. New geometry exports must use explicit `save <file> ascii`; CSV metrics are parsed by header name and coordinate files by numeric XYZ rows.
translator_contract: Topology identities are represented by anonymous Txx IDs in public analysis; private/topologies.json contains the KnotPlot construction mapping.
